name: xshelf
description: A local-first shelf for your X bookmarks.

scripts.check: node --check src/background.js && node --check src/app.js && node --check src/lib/db.js && node --check src/lib/search.js && node --check src/lib/link-preview.js && node --check src/lib/profile-url.js && node --check src/lib/x-capture.js && node --check src/x-profile.js && node --check src/lib/x-sync.js
scripts.package: npm run check && npm test && mkdir -p dist && zip -qr dist/xshelf.zip manifest.json rules.json app.html src icons README.md PRIVACY.md -x '*.DS_Store'
